messages:
olga: dropping v1 of a compact autoscale row that tries to surface min/max steppers, an SLO control, and a tiny burst affordance all on one line. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newfile/compact-rows (frame Compact-A)
jason: nice direction. main ask: show a tiny cost + latency microline only when pool changes or on hover, otherwise the single line stays clean. avoid permanent clutter.
amanda: copy: prefer 'Short burst' over 'Burst capacity'. also 'Latency target (ms)' for the SLO label — clearer for less technical users.
lee: accessibility nits: 1) burst icon must have aria-label including pool name, 2) stepper changes announced via aria-live="polite", 3) focus order should be min -> max -> SLO -> burst, 4) contrast for small labels must be >=4.5:1.
sara: keyboard + mobile: steppers need left/right arrow support and direct typing. for mobile ensure 44px touch targets; current steppers are 36px and will fail. burst popover must open on tap and close on backdrop.
devon: engineering note: debounce saves at 600-750ms, persist last-used burst quanta per pool (localStorage) so users don't reconfigure each time. compute cost delta client-side on pool switch using cached throughput profiles to avoid spamming API.
jason: UX detail: make the burst a 16px thunder icon with a 1px divider between steppers and burst. when burst is enabled show a small caret so users know it opens a popover.
amanda: guardrail copy tweak: change "We may scale below your min during outages" -> "Autoscaling may temporarily reduce capacity under extreme conditions" (less alarming). Also tooltip for short burst should show duration, est tokens/min, and est cost/min. keep tooltip <250 chars and keyboard-focusable.
lee: propose adding a PR checklist: stepper arrow keys, aria-live, aria-labels with pool name, focus order validation, contrast check, tooltip focusable, mobile touch target verification. paste this into the ticket.
olga: thanks all 10 I'll update the mock: swap to 'Short burst', add 1px divider, make burst icon-only with accessible label and focus ring, include a hover microline for cost/latency and persist burst quanta per pool. will push v2 by EOD and add the PR accessibility checklist. :rocket:
